title: Sublinearly Structured Deep Neural Networks Achieve Feature Learning Consistency for Compositional Functions
summary: Over the past decade, deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success on complex machine-learning tasks, yet the theoretical foundations of their performance remain incomplete. From a statistical viewpoint, a natural question is: can DNNs attain feature-learning and prediction consistency comparable to that of classical models? While a full characterization is open, we provide positive results for a broad subclass.
